result.title: Cross3DGS: Unified Vulkan-Based 3D Gaussian Splatting Training from Workstations to Mobile Devices
result.comment: Accepted to the WACV 2027 Workshop on Eyes of the Future (EOF). 19 pages including appendix
result.summary: Scenes captured with handheld and wearable cameras are still shipped to a CUDA workstation for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) training. Training on the device that captured them, or on its companion phone or laptop, requires more than translating kernels: GPUs and drivers differ in parallel features, memory limits, and command submission, and these differences decide whether a training schedule executes and returns the correct update. We present Cross3DGS, a cross-vendor, cross-platform Vulkan trainer that keeps one optimizer and chooses its execution schedule per device in two steps: rules on device limits, workload size, and observed driver failures exclude the schedules known not to run correctly, and a fixed preference order selects one of the remaining feasible schedules. The same core completes standard-quality training (30k updates, one million Gaussians) on every configuration we measured, spanning NVIDIA, Intel, Arm, Qualcomm, AMD, and Apple GPUs and including Android devices and an iPhone, whereas the existing portable trainers VkSplat and Brush do not run on some of the mobile GPUs. Averaged over 11 scenes on a workstation, Cross3DGS has higher quality than VkSplat with no significant difference in training time, and Brush reports about three times the training time at comparable quality. The final quality of Cross3DGS is nearly identical across devices. A mobile application turns a handheld capture into a viewable model entirely on the device.

AI.brief_summary: Cross3DGS 提出一个基于 Vulkan 的跨厂商、跨平台 3D Gaussian Splatting 训练器，通过按设备资源限制和驱动失败情况筛选可行的执行调度，使训练可在工作站、手机与 Apple 设备上完成。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作聚焦 3DGS 训练的可移植性与图形后端工程，不涉及内部视觉推理状态、证据筛选、停止决策或 latent 生成，其按硬件约束选择调度的机制也仅与「动态计算」字面相似，缺少可核查的实质借鉴线索，故排除。
